nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Bản thân & gia đình · bài tự soạn
kind: Hội thoại 2 người bạn nói về nghề
L: A
So, Ben, what do you do for a living?
B
I'm a nurse at a children's hospital.
A
Wow, that must be tiring. Do you work nights?
B
Sometimes. I'm on night shift three days a week.
A
I couldn't do that. I'm hopeless without sleep.
B
You get used to it. What about you?
A
I'm a freelance illustrator. I work from home.
B
Nice! Is it hard to find work?
A
At first, yes. Now friends keep recommending me.
B
That's great. I can't even draw a stick figure!
A
Ha! Come over some time and I'll teach you.
B
Deal! But don't expect too much.

exq.why: “I'm a nurse at a children's hospital.” = Ben là y tá.

exq.q: How often does Ben work night shifts?
exq.why: “I'm on night shift three days a week.” = trực đêm ba ngày một tuần.
“I work from home.” = làm việc ở nhà.

exq.q: How does Lan find work now?
exq.why: “Now friends keep recommending me.” = giờ bạn bè giới thiệu mình.
